translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: HECHOS
book.title: An t’ajbilab ax in t’ajamal an abathualechic

content: In hualab a Ananías ani a Safira
Hua’ats jaye jun i ebchalab im bij Ananías in nuju in tsabalil. In tomquil pel a Safira.

In canchi hue’ an tumin c’al ax ti jalbinchat c’al an tsabal, ani axi más jats im binanchi tin c’ubac an abathualechic. In ucha’ abal ja’its tim patal an tumin axi jalbinchame. Expith in tomquil jats in tso’obna’ abal yab chubax.

Tam uchan a Ananías c’al a Pedro: ―Tata’ ojni’ a hualca’ ta ba’ ti otsanchi ta ichich a Satanás abal ti t’ajchi quit janamcahuin. It hualbinenec c’al an Espíritu Santo cum a canchi hue’ an tumin jahua’ tit jalbinchame.

Nixe’ xi tsabal pel a lej c’al tam ti yabaye a nujumal, ani tam tit jalbinchamejits tam nixe’ xi tumin pel a lej c’al. A ejtohuamalac ca eyentha’ jant’inits a culbetal, ani yab quit janamcahuin. Xo’ ojni’ it janamcahuinits c’al a Dios, ani yab expith c’al huahua’ it janamcaunenec.
Tam tin ats’a’its antsana’ a Ananías, tam t’ajat ijcan tsemenec. Ani lej jiq’uey patal jitats in tso’obna’ abal antsana’ ti tsemetsits jun jic’tohual.
Chich i cuitolchic ani in thu’banchi in inictal, in ne’tha’ quin joliy.
Ox i hora talbel tam ti otsitsits in tomquil a Ananías. Yab in tso’bim max tsemenequits a Ananías.
Tam uchan c’al a Pedro: ―Tiquin ucha’ an chubaxtalab max jats antsana’ tin nujumal an tsabal a q’uimathil jant’ini’ tin olchamalits jaja’. Toc’tsin jaja’ in ulu: ―Ojni’ chubax ja’its antsana.

Tam uchan c’al a Pedro: ―¿Tata’ ojni’ jale’ a juncu an cau quit junax janamcahuin c’al a q’uimathil? It hualbinenecte c’al an Espíritu Santo. Te huichits an cuitolchic ax in ne’tha’ quin joliy a q’uimathil, ani tata’te ne’ets ti ne’tha’ quit jolin.

Ani tameq’ui ti t’ajat ijcan tsemenec jaye a Safira tin acan a Pedro. Otsits alta an cuitolchic ani in tsu’u mo’ol tsemenequits. In caltha’ in ne’tha’chic jaye ani in joliy utat jun ti jolithits in q’uimathil Ananías.
Ani jats ti lej jiq’uey patal im bichohuil a Dios ani patal jitats in tso’obna’ abal antsana’ t’ajat tsemetsits a Ananías ani a Safira.
I labith t’ajbilab ax u t’ajnal ti tsu’bixtalab c’al an inicchic

An abathualechic in t’ajale yan i labith t’ajbilab ti tsu’bixtalab c’al an inicchic. Ani taley tamcun c’al jaja’chic yantalam i belom tin hueu cucu’il an tiyopan. Im bij nixe’ xi hueu cucu’lab Salomón.
Patal pel i belom axi tamcuth, cum axi yab belom in ts’ejnal ca tamcun. Aba ani’ yab in inicnal tim ba’ ca tamcun c’al am belomchic, bel in lej c’ac’nalchic.
Ani lej yanenel ne’ets am belom c’al an Ajatic, i inic ani i uxum.

U chi’thachicab ti bel yan i ya’ul c’al i lactem ani q’ue’at c’al i tseyte’ tat, ani u mo’cab jun ti ne’ets ca huat’ey a Pedro. Lej lequitsq’ui max ca huat’ey a Pedro ani ca tsalamliyat, c’al ca t’ajat jeltha.
Taja’ ti Jerusalén u ulelel yantalam i inic axi tal al i bichouchic axi utat. In chi’thachicalchic i ya’ul ani axi co’oyab c’al i at’ax teneclab. Tim patal u jelthathayab c’al an abathualechic.
Baliyat al an huic’axte’ a Pedro ani a Juan
Taley lej pa’ixnanchab in tsap an abathualechic c’al an ts’ale pale’ ani c’al an cuenel saduceo axi ts’at’at c’al jaja’ an ts’ale pale’.
Jaxtam yac’uanchic ani baliyat al an huic’axte’.
Ani taja a Dios in aba’ jun i ángel abal quin japchi in hui’lebil an huic’axte’ tam acal. In caltha’ an abathualechic ani in ucha’:
―Quit c’alechic ti al an tiyopan ani ca olchi an inicchic jant’ini’ ta ca it ejatliyat c’al an Ajatic.

Tam tin ats’a’its antsana’ an abathualechic, tam c’alechic ani otsits ti al an tiyopan ti exobchix. Thajuhuits tamna’. C’uajate ti exobchix an abathualechic ti al an tiyopan, ani an ts’ale pale’ ani in tolmihualchic in tamcuy an yejtselabchic Israel axi pel i cuenel ts’ejcom cau axi lej c’athpich exbath in ey. Cum in tsalpayalchic abal c’uajate an abathualechic ti al an huic’axte’ in aba’ i ic’tom ca ic’tatchic.
Tam ti ulitschic an ic’tom tihua’ al an huic’axte’ yab jita’ hua’ats. Huichits jaja’chic c’al an cuenel ts’ejcom cau quin olchi yab jita’ hua’ats.
In ucha’chic: ―I tsu’u tocat mapuputhits an huic’axte’ ani lej alhua’ beletnanath c’al i soldadochic. Tam tu japchatits an hui’leb, ni jita’ yab hua’ats.

Tam tin ats’a’its antsana’ an cau an ts’ale pale’, ani c’al an oc’lec c’al am beletnom tiyopanchic, ani c’al am pale’chic axi lej exbath, tam jilc’onchic lej c’upupul in tsalap. In uluchic jant’o hualam t’ajnenec ani ne’ets ca más t’ajane.
Taley tameq’ui ulcan c’al jaja’chic jun i inic in ulu: ―An inicchic ax a baliyamal al an huic’axte’ tihua’ c’uajat ti al an tiyopan ti exobchix junil c’al an inicchic.

Tam an oc’lec c’al am beletnom tiyopanchic, ani c’al nixe’ xi ic’tomchic c’alechic quin iq’ui’ an abathualechic c’al i lej c’aya’talab. Yab ic’tat c’al i othnaxtalab, cum an ic’tomchic in ts’ejnal max ca cui’iyat c’al i t’ujub c’al am bichou.
In ultha’itschic tin tamet an cuenel ts’ejcom cau. Tam an ts’ale pale’ in ucha’ an abathualechic:

―Huahua’ tu lej tsapic uchamalits abal yabats jita’ ca más exobchichiquiy tin cuenta a Jesús. Bel a t’ajalchic, ma tim patal an c’uajilom teje’ ti bichou Jerusalén in ats’amalits a exobchixtal. Ani jaye a le’chic tucu jolbiy c’al in tsemtal a Jesús.

Tam toc’tsin a Pedro ani axi q’ue’at an abathualechic in uluchic: ―Pel i uchbil qui oc’ox t’ajchi jahua’ tucu abatna’ a Dios. Yab qui t’ajchi jahua’ tucu abatna’ i inic max yab juncuth in tsalap c’al a Dios.
Ojni’ tata’chic a tsemtha’ a Jesús ti al i pelc’oth te’, ani pel in Diosil i biyal at juntal c’al ti ejtha a Jesús tam ti tsemenequits.

Ja’its a Dios ax in c’uajba’ a Jesús tin huinab c’ubac jant’ini’ ti puhuethanchithits im bij. Im punuhuits ti Ts’ale Abatnom ani ti Jec’onthax c’al an inicchic. Xo’ a Dios in le’ abal huahua’ tu Israelchic cu jic’tson c’al i hualab ani cu paculanchat i hualab.
Lej chububul axe’ xi cau jahua’ i olnal, ani jaye an Espíritu Santo in olnal xe’. Ja’its jaja’ an Espíritu Santo u pithnal c’al a Dios jitats quin t’ajchi jahua’ a Dios in le’.
Tam tin ats’a’its antsana’ axe’ xi cau an cuenel ts’ejcom cau, tam ti lej tsacuy, ma in le’ quin tsemtha’ an abathualechic.
Tam cubiy jun jaja’chic im bij Gamaliel. Pel i fariseo ax u exobchix c’al an ts’ejcath cau binath c’al a Moisés ani lej c’ac’nab c’al am bichou. In ulu ca ne’tha eleb jun i hue’ an abathualechic.
Tam in ucha’ an cuenel ts’ejcom cau: ―At Israelchic, ca lej t’aja’ ti cuenta jahua’ a le’ ca t’ajchi axe’ xi inicchic.

Ca t’ila’chic jant’o t’ajchin a Teudas ax in ulu in lej cua’al in cuete’ c’athat ey. Tocat tsemtha jaja’ ani tala’ pit’c’ochiquin axi tse’ i bo’chic inic in ts’at’elil. T’ajat taley nixe’ xi pulic cuenel.
Ani talbel tam tin q’uichajil ca penan am bijlab, ts’at’enec yan i inic c’al a Judas Galileajib. Tsemtha jaja’ jaye ani tala’ pit’c’ochiquinchic in ts’at’elil.
Jaxtam nan tu uchalchic yab ca t’apchi in t’ojlabil axe’ xi inicchic. Ne’ets ca cuete’ taley in t’ojlabil max pel in cuete’ c’al expith.
Max pel in c’al a Dios yab ne’ets ca ejtouchic ca t’apchi. Ca lej alhua’ t’aja’ ti cuentachic, lequitsq’ui hualam expith a tomolnanchal in t’ojlabil a Dios.

Ani patal an cuenel ts’ejcom cau in tsalpay abal lej chubax jahua’ in ulu a Gamaliel. Aba ani’ antsana’ uchanits, bel in abchi an cau ca chi’tha an abathualechic ani ca huithc’oyat. In lej tsapic ucha’chic yabats más quin olnanchiye jita’ im bij a Jesús. Tam in hualca’chic ca c’alets.
Ani tamna’ calejits an abathualechic taja’ ti al an cuenel ts’ejcom cau, c’alechic lej culbel cum pithnenec an q’uij c’al a Dios ca pojca tin cuenta im bij a Jesús.
Chuthel chuthel ti al an tiyopan ani ti q’uimathchic xe’etschic ti exobchix c’al in cahuintal a Dios ani ti olnanchix c’al im bij a Jesucristo.
